kode-mini.title: KODE.MINI
kode-mini.summary: A local-first conversational assistant implemented with Python decision rules.
kode-mini.description: KODE.MINI is an inspectable Python assistant that classifies prompts and produces responses from built-in rules and knowledge. It does not contain neural-network weights or call an external model API. Run the local server to try the model, or browse its source here.
kode-mini.notes: The existing source file identifies its license as MIT. Keep its original author and license notice when redistributing it.

kode-mini-project.title: KODE.MINI project
kode-mini-project.summary: The complete KODE.MINI project notes and source entry point.
kode-mini-project.description: Read the package notes for the KODE.MINI offline assistant, then download the Python engine. The expanded knowledge-base data is not included in the public download listing until its redistribution terms are confirmed.
kode-mini-project.notes: The Python engine is available separately from the project notes.

openkode-website.title: Open-Kode website
openkode-website.summary: The full source for the Open-Kode website and Python server.
openkode-website.description: Download the website’s HTML, responsive CSS, JavaScript, PNG logo, and Python backend in one archive. The site includes a public library, account sign-in, the KODE.MINI AI playground, and API key management.
openkode-website.notes: The Open-Kode website source is licensed under MIT. Local account passwords are stored as salted scrypt hashes. The Python server is needed for accounts and KODE.MINI API requests.
